Inspection of B-782 (HomeWare, kitchen appliance cartons) found 18 of 40 units defective, a defect_rate_pct of 45.0. The defect is crushed cartons, severity major. Inspector notes say origin QC passed with photos and the crush damage is consistent with stacking during transit.

policy_rules_applied: Late Shipment Policy v3 rule 3: escalate to logistics when (days_late >= 3 AND key account). Findings: days_late = 3, customer tier = key_account, so escalation is required.
Late Shipment Policy v3 rule 4: P1 for key accounts.

Quality Flag Policy v2 rule 3: escalate to quality when severity == 'critical' OR defect_rate_pct >= 10. Findings: defect_rate_pct = 45.0 (severity major), so escalation to the quality team is also required.
Quality Flag Policy v2 rule 4: P1 only for critical severity, otherwise P2. This is P2 on its own. The overall priority is P1 because the late-shipment rule gives P1 and the ticket is a key account.
required_actions: Escalate to logistics (P1): open a carrier trace with Ecom Express for SH-2018 (root cause: carrier_delay).
Waive freight charges for SH-2018 (key account with days_late >= 3).

Also escalate to the quality team (P2 under the Quality Flag Policy), because defect_rate_pct is 45.0, which is >= 10. The submission tool accepts only one team, so logistics must hand this to quality.
Raise a carrier damage claim for batch B-782 (root cause: damaged_in_transit). Severity is major, not critical, so no quarantine is required by policy.
Send Acme Retail a customer message that acknowledges both issues and says what happens next: carrier trace, freight waiver and damage claim. It must not promise any dates that no tool returned.

communications.customer_message:
Dear Acme Retail team,

We're sorry about both problems with shipment SH-2018. It arrived 3 days after the promised date, and many of the cartons in batch B-782 were crushed. We know this isn't acceptable.

What we found:
- Delivery: The carrier, Ecom Express, collected the shipment from our warehouse on 2026-10-02. It then sat at their Indore hub from 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-06. It was delivered on 2026-10-08 against the promised date of 2026-10-05. The delay was caused by the carrier.
- Damage: Our inspection of B-782 found 18 of 40 units with crushed cartons (45.0%). The damage is consistent with stacking during transit.

What happens next:
1. We have escalated this to our logistics team as a priority (reference ESC-4A872A). They are opening a carrier trace with Ecom Express for SH-2018.
2. We are waiving the freight charges for SH-2018.
3. We are raising a carrier damage claim for batch B-782.
4. Our quality team is being brought in to review the damaged batch.

We don't yet have confirmed dates for the trace outcome or the claim. We will update you as soon as we have them.

Sincerely,
Customer Operations

No quarantine is required by policy. The customer message gives no promised dates.

triage.summary: Nova Electronics reports shipment SH-2019 failed delivery twice because the courier can't find them, and a stock count mismatch at WH-PUNE for SKU-LED-40 is blocking a replacement.

route_reasons: 2 exception types (failed_delivery, inventory_mismatch)

findings.evidence: Two failed attempts (2026-10-07, 2026-10-08), both reason_code address_not_found (building not found; address could not be located). address_verified=false.

GRN-551 receipt of 12 units posted twice on 2026-10-03; dock log says one pallet, 12 units received. system_qty 200 vs physical_qty 188, variance_units -12, variance_pct -6.0. Last cycle count 2026-09-30 (176) matched system.

policy_rules_applied: Inventory Mismatch Policy v2, rule 3: ESCALATE to warehouse_ops when abs(variance_pct) >= 5. variance_pct is -6.0 (variance_units -12, system_qty 200 vs physical_qty 188), so escalation is required.
Inventory Mismatch Policy v2, rule 4: Priority is P1 only if theft or loss is suspected, otherwise P2. The root cause is duplicate_posting, so the priority is P2.

Failed Delivery Policy v4, rule 3: ESCALATE to logistics only when failed_attempts >= 3 or the shipment is temperature_controlled. SH-2019 has failed_attempts 2 and temperature_controlled false, so failed delivery does not require escalation on its own.
Overall: at least one exception type requires escalation, so escalate=true.
required_actions: Inventory (duplicate_posting): reverse the duplicate GRN-551 entry (12 units posted twice on 2026-10-03) for SKU-LED-40 at WH-PUNE.
Failed delivery (address_issue): contact Nova Electronics to verify the delivery address before the next attempt on SH-2019 (address_verified=false; 2 failed attempts, reason code address_not_found).
Customer message: tell Nova Electronics that we are verifying their address and correcting the stock record that is blocking the replacement. Say what happens next and do not promise any dates.

communications.customer_message:
Dear Nova Electronics team,

We're sorry that delivery of SH-2019 has failed twice and that the stock issue is now holding up your replacement LED panels (SKU-LED-40).

Delivery: The courier, Shadowfax, attempted delivery on 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08. Both attempts failed because the building could not be found. Your delivery address is not yet verified on our side. Before another attempt is made, we will contact you to confirm the exact address and any landmarks or access details that will help the courier find you. Please reply with them if you can.

Replacement stock: We found that a receipt of 12 units at our WH-PUNE warehouse was recorded twice in our system on 2026-10-03. This made the stock count wrong, and that is what has been blocking your replacement. We have escalated this to our warehouse operations team (reference ESC-4A2592) to reverse the duplicate entry and correct the record.

We can't give you a firm date for either step yet. We'll update you as soon as the address is confirmed and the stock record is corrected.

Our apologies again for the inconvenience.
communications.internal_note: T19: Escalated to warehouse_ops P2 (ESC-4A2592) for duplicate GRN-551 posting on SKU-LED-40 at WH-PUNE (variance -12 units, -6.0%). Failed delivery SH-2019 (2 attempts, address_not_found, address_verified=false) doesn't meet the logistics escalation threshold. Action for us: contact Nova to verify the address before the next attempt. No dates promised to the customer.
